trade_offer.message: Ed, I'm doing you a favor here. You take a QB you don't need behind your golden boy and a solid back off my bench, I take Jeanty off your hands before he gets you beat again. Everybody wins, mostly me. Clock's ticking.

note_reply: No note? Good. Nothing to disagree with. I'll keep winning without the memo.
forum_post: Christian Watson just dropped 29.7 on a team that thought I couldn't field a lineup, and I'm about to add another name to the pile because I'm feeling it, not because a spreadsheet told me to. Ed Monix, I sent you a trade that helps you way more than it helps me — take it before I change my mind and just take Jeanty for free next week. QB aisle's still mine. Kris, you're welcome for the copy.
